description: Recurse Stereo: passes a stereo pair out and back through an effect up to 16 times in one go, giving each pass its own polyphony channel

params.text: Sets how many times each input channel goes round the send and return loop, 1 to 16, alike on both sides. Its display is yellow while every channel fits within 16 and red while channels are dropped
Multiplied with the SCALE input to give the factor both sides are multiplied by, so the loop can ring modulate
Added to the OFFSET input to give the voltage added to both sides
Sets when the scale and offset are applied on both sides: 1Pre once before the first send, nPre before every send, nPost after every return, 1Post once after the last return

inputs.text: Multiplied with the SCALE knob to give the factor both sides are multiplied by; channels beyond those at the left input are ignored
Added to the OFFSET knob to give the voltage added to both sides; channels beyond those at the left input are ignored
Takes the processed passes of its own side back in, channel for channel with the send on that side; unpatched it takes that send itself
The left signal to be processed. Its channel count sets the polyphony for both sides, and that count multiplied by the recursion count must be 16 or less
The right signal to be processed; unpatched it takes the left input, and any channels beyond the left input's count are ignored

outputs.text: Carries every pass of every channel of the input on its own side, the input channel count multiplied by the recursion count, with the passes of one channel consecutive
The signal of its own side after its last return, with the same channels as the left input apart from any that were dropped

menu: Order of operation — Scale before offset or Offset before scale, and a small lamp glows yellow beside whichever of the two comes first
